en-CA.description: Plextreme is an Alexa skill which allows you to play music hosted by your plex media server
examplePhrases: Alexa ask Plextreme to play some music
Alexa ask Plextreme to play rock music
en-CA.name: Plextreme
en-CA.summary: Skill for playing music from your media server
